verdict.rationale: Gusto's official agent-friendly CLI has a payroll-prep skill that maps an owner's inputs onto a draft payroll for review. It also offers `--dry-run` previews of create requests and a `--confirm` gate that keeps a human in the loop, and the API can list unprocessed payrolls. A preview endpoint with submission blockers is documented only for contractor payment groups, not regular payroll runs, and nothing shows automated anomaly detection. missing for 10: a documented regular-payroll preview/calculate API, automated anomaly detection and surfacing, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent run a payroll preview via the API and surface anomalies for review before I approve the run

citations.quote: payroll-prep (maps an owner's per-cycle inputs onto a draft payroll for review)
--dry-run previews any create request; writes in agent mode are blocked with a confirmation_required envelope (exit 8) until re-run with --confirm, keeping a human in the loop.
Upcoming regular payrolls can be retrieved by calling GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/payrolls with processing_statuses=unprocessed.
You can use the POST /v1/companies/{company_id}/contractor_payment_groups/preview to validate inputs, determine how fast a payment can be made for a company, and handle any submission blockers.
